payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterative DP on 1D array L[v] (v up to 1e6) representing longest chain ending at v. For each v in set, update multiples x: L[x] = max(L[x], L[v]+1) via sieve-like loops.
payload.rationale: The solution maintains a 1D DP state (array L) and transitions by iterating multiples, which is classic for 1D DP on a DAG of divisibility. No 2D structure, recursion, trees, intervals, or bitmasks are used.
